race.comment: I SAY I SAY (6) made it three minor placings from his last four runs when a closing third over 1666m at Ipswich last time out. Racing well and gives every indication he will get this trip. FIVE OF US (12) led and gave a kick but found the winner too strong over this distance at the Sunshine Coast recently. Making a habit of filling minor placings of late. Sure to give backers a sight again. BOSCATINE (5) raced beyond a sprint trip for the first time last start and did a fair job to finish just over three lengths from the winner here on the poly track. Can make further progress and feature in the finish. BILLS ANGEL (8) turned in an eye-catcher at Grafton last time and will be hard to hold out. RAFA (7) has showed ability in three runs to date. Blinkers go on for the first time today which might take her to another level.
